contexts.text: From the twentieth to the sixtieth year... is called manhood, etc. HH 166.
The honourable marks of virility at once failed them (when they thought of more wives than one).
How is the feminine principle propagated from a masculine soul?
The loveliness... of the female sex surpassing the male sex.
The virile potency (of adulterers) when they become husbands, may be compared to the blossoming of tulips...
The speech (of these Spirits) is not so manly...
